prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Click to pet, drag to move, or right-click for quick controls."]
1: ["Your pet will automatically pop up on your desktop when ready. Keep this window open during setup."]
2: ["Sign in to save your desktop pet", "Connect your account to sync your pet settings and prevent pet resets on reinstall.", "Returning user? Sign in with your previous login method to restore your active pets."]
3: ["Use a clear, front-facing pet photo with good lighting for best custom generation."]
4: ["Select Your Desktop Friend", "Choose a classic preset buddy or generate a custom companion from your photos."]
5: ["Which pet experience do you want?", "Pick a quick ready-made desktop pet or upload photos to craft your custom companion."]
6: ["Your adoption certificate registers your pet's permanent ID to your device.", "Permanent Pet ID Registered"]
7: ["Control your pet anytime by right-clicking it on your desktop or clicking its system tray icon."]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Choose a pre-made friend to launch instantly, or create a personalized pet from your photos.", "Start Pet Setup"]
9: ["Feel free to minimize this app. We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"]
